source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_APPENDIX::U01: Navigate partnership relationship,third-party exposure and registration separately

payload.title: The same partner event can create several different questions
payload.core_explanation_md:
A partner departure can affect internal settlement, third-party liability, bank mandate and public notice. Locate each relevant provision rather than assuming one retirement letter answers all of them. Mutual rights, external agency, dissolution and registration-related suit restrictions sit in different statutory paths.

The appendix includes registration provisions and fee material with State-specific features. Do not generalise those details nationally or treat a historical fee schedule as current reference data. Identify the State, the actual firm record and the law version before teaching an exact procedural charge or deadline.

self_check.prompt_text: Can an internal exit settlement alone establish creditor release?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. External liability and discharge require separate evidence.
